_version_note: v1.1.0 resolves SOURCE-01 from REVAS Pilot 1 audit: HOLD/REJECT distinction now self-contained in the canonical atom. condition_for_rejection now explicitly encodes the terminal predicate so no external email clarification is required to distinguish pending-incomplete from terminally-incomplete.

framework_mappings.requirement: Unique user identification and access control for PHI systems
Policies for AI risk management established and communicated
AI risk assessment — identify risks to individuals from AI system outputs

constraint.description: AI-generated recommendations affecting PHI must not be adopted into the health record without explicit human authorization from a credentialed clinician with documented authority over the patient record.
constraint.scope: Any AI system output that would result in creation, modification, or deletion of protected health information in an EHR.
authority_requirements: Approving actor must hold a valid clinical credential recognized by the organization
Approving actor must have documented access authority for the specific patient record
Dual authorization required if patient is flagged as sensitive category (mental health, substance abuse, HIV/AIDS)
evidence_requirements: Minimum necessary standard must be satisfied — AI system must log which PHI fields were accessed to generate the recommendation
Model version, input hash, and output hash must be recorded before authorization is requested
Authorization event must be logged with actor identity, timestamp, and reason code

adoption_gate.default: HOLD — recommendation is a candidate state until authorization is complete
adoption_gate.condition_for_escalation: Dual authorization required if sensitive_category == true

hold_reject_semantics.HOLD: Conditions are temporarily incomplete and still satisfiable. The authorization window is open. The candidate state is preserved. Downstream propagation is blocked. HOLD applies when required actors have not yet been asked or have not yet responded, when the authorization window has not expired, and when authority has not been invalidated.
hold_reject_semantics.REJECT: Conditions are terminally incomplete or authority is invalid. REJECT applies when: (a) a required actor's authority cannot be confirmed or has been revoked; (b) evidence is permanently unresolvable (e.g., required provenance data was never recorded and cannot be reconstructed); or (c) the authorization window has expired without completion. Reject and quarantine the candidate state.

adoption_gate.condition_for_rejection: Reject and quarantine if: (a) authority cannot be confirmed or has been revoked (terminal, not merely pending); or (b) evidence is permanently unresolvable and cannot be reconstructed; or (c) the authorization window has expired. Pending-incomplete conditions where required actors have not yet responded are HOLD, not REJECT.
adoption_gate.hold_reject_precedence: When conditions are incomplete, apply HOLD if the incompleteness is remediable and the authorization window is open. Apply REJECT only when the incompleteness is terminal or authority is invalid. HOLD takes precedence over the literal rejection clause for remediable conditions.

provenance.receipt_format: TrustLedger — SHA-256 hash of adopted state, anchored to external timestamp, linked to authorization event
provenance.rollback_trigger: If authorization is later found to be unauthorized, all downstream adopted states derived from this recommendation must be flagged for reverification

attestation_metadata.posture_contribution: 18% of overall AI governance posture score for healthcare domain
